tools.name: echo
tools.title: Echo
tools.description: Echo the input text back to the caller. Useful for verifying MCP connectivity.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.title: Search JBJ projects
tools.description: Search JBJ Global Real Estate's PUBLISHED off-plan and ready projects. Filters: keyword (matched against name, developer, location), emirate, min/max price in AED, and bedroom count. Returns up to 20 projects with public URL, developer, emirate, price range, bedroom range, handover date, and cover image.

query.description: Free-text keyword matched against project name, developer name, and location.

emirate.description: Emirate filter — 'Dubai', 'Abu Dhabi', 'Sharjah', 'Ras Al Khaimah', 'Ajman', 'Umm Al Quwain', 'Fujairah'.

bedrooms.description: Bedroom count that must appear in the project's available layouts (0 = studio).

tools.name: get_project
tools.title: Get JBJ project by slug
tools.description: Fetch full public detail for a single JBJ project by its URL slug (e.g. the trailing segment of https://jbj.ae/project/<slug>). Returns developer, emirate, location, price range, bedroom types, handover date, description, cover image and public URL.

tools.name: list_developers
tools.title: List JBJ developers
tools.description: List UAE property developers featured on JBJ Global Real Estate. Returns each developer's name, slug, active project count and public URL. Never returns internal contact details, office locations, or unverified fields.

query.description: Optional keyword filter matched against developer name.
